source: EPA CyAN per-lake pixel counts (about 300 m pixels)
note: Each lake: [day, level, day, level, ...]. day = days since 1970-01-01 (a satellite image day); level = EPA's satellite level (0-253) that at least 5% of the pixels the satellite saw reached; 0 = below detection. cells/mL = 10^(0.012 x level - 4.2) x 100,000,000. Days with no usable look are left out. Last 120 days.
